title: Filtered-colimit continuity of derived functions on profinite parameters
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site with finite jointly surjective covering families, in the compatible universes of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention]. Use ordinary internal modules and their ordinary unbounded derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. For a profinite set $P$, let $R[P]$ be the free internal $R$-module on $S\mapsto C(S,P)$, meaning the left adjoint of forgetting modules to condensed sets. Write $H_P(M)=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_R(R[P],M)$, the internal module Hom right adjoint to internal tensor, and derive it in its second variable by nonnegative injective resolutions [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $I$ be a small filtered category in the module universe and $M:I\to\operatorname{Mod}_R$ a diagram. Filtered means nonempty, every finite diagram admits a cocone. The canonical comparison is an isomorphism
$$\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I} RH_P(M_i[0])\longrightarrow RH_P((\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}M_i)[0])$$
in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_R)$. The left colimit is the exact filtered-colimit functor applied to a compatible diagram of complexes; equivalently its total left derived functor. The comparison is induced by the original coprojections $M_i\to\operatorname{colim}_iM_i$. It is natural in diagrams, continuous maps of profinite parameter sets, and morphisms of the supplied modules. No finite cohomological-dimension hypothesis on $P$ and no interchange of an unbounded product with a filtered colimit is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0GN3 (lemma-colim-global), applied to the coherent profinite slice sites; derived internal-function formulation by evaluating on profinite test sets.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-profinite-free-functions-section-transport] to the stated coherent profinite site and $R$. It supplies finite products, subcanonicity, exact filtered module colimits, the identification of free objects and internal Hom, and transport of the specified resolution cocone to ordinary section-ring modules. Thus it suffices to prove the transported comparison invertible; write $F_i=UM_i$ and $F_\infty=U M_\infty=\operatorname{colim}_iF_i$.

source.place: Tag 03EK (section-tensor-product) and Tag 03EO (lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor); agent extraction of former parent step 1: section-action/tensor transport, subcanonicity by compact quotient descent, and termwise resolution transport.

proof.text: Every covering family in this presentation is finite, and its pullbacks and composites remain finite jointly surjective profinite families. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-cover-derived-presheaf-continuity] to $F:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$. Its derived-presheaf comparison $\delta_F$ is an isomorphism, with the original coefficient coprojections. This includes arbitrary small filtered categories, not just directed preorders, and imposes no bound on the nonzero positive cohomological degrees.

source.place: Tag 09YP (lemma-colimit), constant inverse system on the opposite of the index with an initial zero coefficient adjoined; Section 01FT (section-cohomology-sheaves), injective-resolution evaluation. Agent derived-presheaf formulation of former parent steps 2 and 3.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-free-functions-colimit-model-comparison] to the transported compatible resolutions. Its hypothesis is exactly the invertibility of $\delta_F$ established in step 2, so it proves that their comparison $c$ is a quasi-isomorphism and that $Q(c)$ is invertible. By [lem-sfb-profinite-free-functions-section-transport], the section-action equivalence carries this map back to the original comparison. Hence that comparison is invertible in the ordinary unbounded derived category. The criterion works degree by degree through exact filtered colimits and the derived free-representable model; no unbounded product is interchanged with a colimit.

source.place: Tag 08J7 (section-internal-hom), injective Hom model; sites.tex Tag 00WJ (lemma-sheafification-exact). Agent extraction of former parent step 4: cohomology calculation using the existing derived free-representable model and exact filtered colimits; a conditional quasi-isomorphism criterion.

proof.text: For a morphism of coefficient diagrams the comparison square agrees after every colimit coprojection, hence commutes by the colimit universal property. For $P\!\prime\to P$, restriction along $W\times P\!\prime\to W\times P$ commutes with each coefficient map. The coefficient and parameter naturality of [lem-sfb-profinite-free-functions-section-transport] and [lem-sfb-free-functions-colimit-model-comparison] preserve these squares under transport and localization. This proves all asserted naturalities, with the original module maps.

source.place: Tag 08J7 (section-internal-hom), functoriality of the injective Hom model, and the normalization in lem-sfb-free-representable-derived-functions-model.

proof_origin.place: Finite-cover continuity from Tag 09YP specialized to a constant site, with the derived-presheaf/internal-Hom construction of Tags 08J7 and 03FD. Written-out synthesis, not a verbatim proof of an existing source theorem.

A: a finite jointly surjective family into a profinite set is a quotient map, so the site is subcanonical; E(R[P]) is L_P because E preserves underlying sheaves; E H_P is G_P E by uniqueness of right adjoints; U is exact and faithful, so it detects quasi-isomorphisms. In the parent, U composed with E is the original forgetful functor, so B's conclusion is exactly C's hypothesis. Edge cases pass: P empty or a point, R = 0, a terminal or zero diagram; an empty I is excluded. I checked the base nodes added since the prior head and searched the snapshot by concept. lean.statement: theorem comparison_isIso (R : Ring.{u}) (P : Profinite.{u}) {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (M : I ⥤ Modules R) (K : I ⥤ CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ) (s : M ⋙ HomologicalComplex.single (Modules R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 ⟶ K) (c : Cocone K) (sLimit : (HomologicalComplex.single (Modules R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (colimit M) ⟶ c.pt) (hs : ∀ i : I, QuasiIso (s.app i)) (hI : ∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), Injective ((K.obj i).X n)) (hneg : ∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), n < 0 → IsZero ((K.obj i).X n)) (hsLimit : QuasiIso sLimit) (hILimit : ∀ n : ℤ, Injective (c.pt.X n)) (hnegLimit : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero (c.pt.X n)) (hcompat : ∀ i : I, s.app i ≫ c.ι.app i = (HomologicalComplex.single (Modules R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).map (colimit.ι M i) ≫ sLimit) : IsIso (comparison R P c)
lean.note: The canonical comparison is stated on arbitrary compatible nonnegative injective resolutions, exactly the complex-colimit convention in the node. Its source is Q of the termwise colimit of internal-Hom complexes and its target is Q of internal Hom of the colimit-module resolution. hcompat fixes every cocone leg by the original module coprojection. The coprojection normalization and coefficient/diagram and profinite-parameter naturality clauses are named in declarations. Ring, Modules and freeParameter are the existing CondensedBar abbreviations/construction; the added landed definition dependency names their owner. freeParameterMap applies the explicit free-abelian-sheafification and Mod.free composite, definitionally the functor defining freeParameter, so the internal-bar theorem is not a statement dependency. No statement correction or new independent notion is introduced.
